title: Wegener was right about continents, wrong about forces
body: Alfred Wegener marshalled fossils, coastlines and rock layers for drifting continents in 1912, but proposed continents ploughing through ocean floor, which physicists rightly calculated impossible. He died in 1930 still ridiculed. Seafloor spreading in the 1960s supplied the missing mechanism, plates rafting whole oceans, and rehabilitated his evidence wholesale.
